issues.ko: 상대가 협력을 고른다는 것을 알고 있다.
issues.en: It is known that the opponent will choose Cooperate.
issues.explanation: The Korean omits the subject, and in this first-person frame ('나와 상대', '내 점수') the natural reading is '(I) know'. The passive 'It is known' is impersonal; it does not change the best response, but first person is closer and parallel to the rest of the item.
issues.suggested_en: I know that the opponent will choose Cooperate.

issues.ko: 상대가 Y를 고른다는 것을 알고 있다.
issues.en: It is known that the opponent will choose Y.
issues.explanation: The Korean omits the subject, and in this first-person frame ('나와 상대', '내 점수') the natural reading is '(I) know'. The passive 'It is known' is impersonal; it does not change the best response, but first person is closer and parallel to the rest of the item.
issues.suggested_en: I know that the opponent will choose Y.

issues.en: It is not known what the opponent will choose.
issues.explanation: Parallel to the '알고 있다' situations: the implied subject is 'I'. Change together with them or not at all.
issues.suggested_en: I do not know what the opponent will choose.
